name: Sone no Yoshitada
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 46); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 10th century.

poems.title: The fishing-boats are tossed about
poems.author: Sone no Yoshitada
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 46
poems.text:
The fishing-boats are tossed about,
When stormy winds blow strong;
With rudder lost, how can they reach
The port for which they long?
So runs the old love-song.

poems.title: 46. 由良の戸を わたる舟人 楫をたえ (Yura no to o wataru funabito kaji o tae)
poems.author: Sone no Yoshitada
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
由良の戸を わたる舟人 楫をたえ
行方もしらぬ 戀の道かな
